                  byc_coin_id_to_melt
                )
              )
            )
          )
          (if (> sf_transfer_amount 0)
            ; send message to treasury coin ensure deposit was made
            (c
              (assert-statute statutes_puzzle_hash STATUTE_TREASURY_MINIMUM_DELTA min_treasury_delta)
              (c
                (list SEND_MESSAGE 0x3f
                  (concat
                    PROTOCOL_PREFIX
                    (sha256tree (c inner_puzzle_hash (c STATUTES_STRUCT (c sf_transfer_amount new_treasury_amount))))
                  )
                  treasury_coin_id
                )
                conditions
              )
            )
            ; else no approvals needed
            conditions
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

ab3ecb4927c417e1085f78e4b73e7ada2ccfad24.name: --circuit-circuit_puzzles-payout
ab3ecb4927c417e1085f78e4b73e7ada2ccfad24.clvm:
;;; this coin (payout coin) is controlled by a surplus auction coin, and is used to pay out funds to the winner of the surplus auction
; the payout coin is created with zero amount, and when it's first spent it's filled with the lot amount from treasury
; if the coin is spent again, its amount is transferred to the winner of the surplus auction
; every spend needs to be approved by the surplus auction coin
(mod (CAT_MOD_HASH
      MOD_HASH
      CRT_TAIL_HASH
      SURPLUS_AUCTION_MOD_HASH
      SURPLUS_AUCTION_LAUNCHER_ID
      inner_puzzle
      inner_solution
    )

  (include *standard-cl-23.1*)
  (include curry.clib)
  (include condition_codes.clib)
  (include prefixes.clib)
  (include utils.clib)
  (include condition_filtering.clib)

  (assign
    input_conditions (a inner_puzzle inner_solution)
    (
      (
        surplus_auction_parent_id ; verify
        surplus_auction_curried_args_hash ; verify
        surplus_auction_amount ; is uint
        puzzle_hash ; verify
        amount ; is uint
      )
      inner_conditions ; don't verify
    ) (filter-and-extract-remark-solution input_conditions () ())
    inner_puzzle_hash (sha256tree inner_puzzle)
    surplus_auction_coin_id (coinid
      surplus_auction_parent_id
      (curry_hashes CAT_MOD_HASH
        (sha256 ONE CAT_MOD_HASH)
        (sha256 ONE CRT_TAIL_HASH)
        ; we're asserting that launcher coin must be using surplus puzzle so we can trust its announcements
        (tree_hash_of_apply SURPLUS_AUCTION_MOD_HASH surplus_auction_curried_args_hash)
      )
      surplus_auction_amount
    )
    (assert
      (is-size-b32 surplus_auction_parent_id)
      (is-size-b32 surplus_auction_curried_args_hash)
      (is-uint64 surplus_auction_amount)
      (is-size-b32-or-nil puzzle_hash)
      (is-uint64 amount)
      (if (all (= surplus_auction_coin_id SURPLUS_AUCTION_LAUNCHER_ID) (= puzzle_hash ()))
        ; first spend of the coin
        (li  ; create / fill the coin from treasury
          ; surplus auction is being created and started, since we should have enough in treasury
          ; to fill this coin, let see. We also guarantee we locked them delegating control to surplus auction coin id
          (list SEND_MESSAGE 0x3f
            (concat PROTOCOL_PREFIX (sha256tree (c inner_puzzle_hash amount)))
            surplus_auction_coin_id
          )
          ; recreate ourselves with the surplus BYC lot amount
          (list
            CREATE_COIN
            (curry_hashes MOD_HASH
              (sha256 ONE MOD_HASH)
              (sha256 ONE CRT_TAIL_HASH)
              (sha256 ONE SURPLUS_AUCTION_MOD_HASH)
              (sha256 ONE SURPLUS_AUCTION_LAUNCHER_ID)
            )
            amount
          )
          ; must be zero when locking the coin. also ensures this spend path can only be taken once
          ; since Surplus Auction Lot Amount > 0 (or ow/ there's no possibility of loss to protocol)
          (list ASSERT_MY_AMOUNT 0)
          &rest
          inner_conditions
        )
        ; we're transferring funds to surplus auction winner,
        ; we don't know if recent surplus coin contains our launcher id, but we're going to assert that with coin ann
        (li
          ; can only transfer full amount
          (list ASSERT_MY_AMOUNT amount)
          ; get confirmation from surplus auction that it indeed wants to transfer funds to the winner (puzzle_hash)
          ; and the winning bid amount to melt
          (list RECEIVE_MESSAGE 0x3f
            (concat
              PROTOCOL_PREFIX
              (sha256tree (c inner_puzzle_hash (c amount (c puzzle_hash SURPLUS_AUCTION_LAUNCHER_ID))))
            )
            surplus_auction_coin_id
          )
          ; transfer out
          (list CREATE_COIN puzzle_hash amount (list puzzle_hash))
          &rest
          inner_conditions
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

8758641e39505ccc42ca3e7c82ccf7cf6158b006.name: --circuit-circuit_puzzles-recharge_auction
8758641e39505ccc42ca3e7c82ccf7cf6158b006.clvm:
(mod (OPERATIONS BYC_TAIL_MOD_HASH
      MOD_HASH STATUTES_STRUCT LAUNCHER_ID AUCTION_PARAMS LAST_BID
      inner_puzzle
      inner_solution
      operation
    )

  (include *standard-cl-23.1*)
  (include prefixes.clib)
  (include utils.clib)
  (include condition_codes.clib)
  (include condition_filtering.clib)
  (include curry.clib)
  (include statutes_utils.clib)

  (assign
    input_conditions (a inner_puzzle inner_solution)
    (
      (
        lineage_proof ; no need to verify
        signed_operation_hash ; verified indirectly
        op_args ; verified in operation programs
      )
      inner_conditions
    ) (filter-and-extract-remark-solution input_conditions () ())
    byc_tail_hash (curry_hashes BYC_TAIL_MOD_HASH (sha256tree STATUTES_STRUCT))
    operation_hash (sha256tree operation)
    inner_puzzle_hash (sha256tree inner_puzzle)
    (assert
      (= signed_operation_hash operation_hash)
      (contains OPERATIONS operation_hash)
      (c
        (list CREATE_COIN_ANNOUNCEMENT ; coin ID to none
          (concat PROTOCOL_PREFIX inner_puzzle_hash)
        ) ; secure attached coins
        (a
          operation
          (list
            (list MOD_HASH STATUTES_STRUCT byc_tail_hash LAUNCHER_ID AUCTION_PARAMS LAST_BID)
            lineage_proof input_conditions inner_puzzle_hash op_args
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

ef499f5334b8f33d3f8ce339fb314e92ce9d7b4c.name: --slot_machine-actions-catalog-refund
ef499f5334b8f33d3f8ce339fb314e92ce9d7b4c.clvm:
; refund.clsp by yakuhito
;; Responsible for returning invalid precommit coins.

;; A precommit coin is considered invalid if:
;; a) the CAT maker puzzle has changed
;; b) the amount is wrong
;; c) the tail hash has already been registered

(mod (
    PRECOMMIT_1ST_CURRY_HASH ; after 1st curry
    SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH ; after 1st curry
    (@
        Truth
        (
            Ephemeral_State . ; not used
            (@
                Current_State
                (Cat_Maker_Puzzle_Hash . Registration_Price)
            )
        )
    )
    ; solution
    (
        precommited_cat_maker_hash ; (sha256tree precommited_cat_maker_reveal)
        precommited_cat_maker_reveal .
        precommited_cat_maker_solution
    ) ; precommit_cat_maker_puzzle_and_solution
    (
        tail_hash ; full TAIL in the reveal of the pre-commit coin
        initial_nft_owner_ph . ; also included in the pre-commit coin
        refund_puzzle_hash_hash ; used to compute precommit coin puzzle hash
    ) ; other_precommit_data
    precommit_amount ; amount of the pre-commit coin
    neighbors . ; (left_tail_hash . right_tail_hash)
    counter ; required if slot spend is needed
)
    (include condition_codes.clib)
    (include sha256tree.clib)
    (include curry.clib)
    (include slots.clib)

    (defun main (SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH spent_slot_value_hash created_slot_value_hash slot_spend_needed base_conditions)
        (if slot_spend_needed
            (c 
                (spend_slot SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH spent_slot_value_hash)
                (c 
                    (create_slot SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH created_slot_value_hash)
                    base_conditions
                )
            )
            ; else
            base_conditions
        )
    )

    (if (= precommited_cat_maker_hash (sha256tree precommited_cat_maker_reveal))
        (c
            Truth ; nothing changes
            (main 
                SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                (sha256tree (c counter (c tail_hash neighbors)))
                (sha256tree (c (+ counter 1) (c tail_hash neighbors)))
                (all
                    (= Registration_Price precommit_amount)
                    (= precommited_cat_maker_hash Cat_Maker_Puzzle_Hash)
                ) ; spend slot only if (a) and (b) are not met
                (list
                    ; announcement
                    (list
                        CREATE_PUZZLE_ANNOUNCEMENT
                        (concat '$'
                            (sha256tree (c tail_hash initial_nft_owner_ph))
                        ) 
                    )

                    ; consume precommit coin
                    (list
                        SEND_MESSAGE
                        19 ; sender puzzle + receiver puzzle + receiver amount
                        0 ; message = 0 = refund
                        (a
                            precommited_cat_maker_reveal
                            (c
                                (curry_hashes PRECOMMIT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                                    refund_puzzle_hash_hash
                                    ; full precommit value reveal is (TAIL . HASH)
                                    ; where HASH = (sha256tree initial_nft_owner_ph cat_maker_hash . cat_maker_solution)
                                    (sha256 2
                                        tail_hash
                                        (sha256 1
                                            (sha256tree (c initial_nft_owner_ph (c precommited_cat_maker_hash precommited_cat_maker_solution)))
                                        )
                                    )
                                ) ; Inner_Puzzle_Hash
                                precommited_cat_maker_solution
                            )
                        ) ; receiver puzzle hash
                        precommit_amount
                      ) 
                ) ; base_conditions
            ) ; conditions
        )
        ; else
        (x)
    )
)

ef34d8e6d6423985d94c13f2a93bcc5608e29d18.name: --slot_machine-actions-catalog-register
ef34d8e6d6423985d94c13f2a93bcc5608e29d18.clvm:
; register.clsp by yakuhito
;; Responsible for registering new CATs into the regstry (CATalog)

;; Main idea: you're the owner of a CAT if you know the TAIL before it's published on-chain
;; To ensure uniqueness (i.e., that no CAT is registered twice), slots are used
;; A double-linked list is created, and a new item is inserted for every new CAT that is registered

;; Slots before insertion:
;; ---------------       ---------------
;; |  left slot  | <---> | right slot  | 
;; ---------------       ---------------
;;
;; Slots after insertion:
;; ---------------       ---------------       ---------------
;; |  left slot  | <---> |  new slot   | <---> | right slot  |
;; ---------------       ---------------       ---------------
;; 
;; A slot's value is (counter . (my_value . (left_value . right_value)))
;; For CATalog, a slot's value is the tail hash of a registered CAT

(mod (
    NFT_PACK ; see 'secure_nft.clib' to see what this contains (packed as tree)
    UNIQUENESS_PRELAUNCHER_1ST_CURRY_HASH ; after 1st curry
    PRECOMMIT_1ST_CURRY_HASH ; after 1st curry
    SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH ; after 1st curry
    (@
        Truth
        (
            Ephemeral_State . ; not used
            (@
                Current_State
                (Cat_Maker_Puzzle_Hash . Registration_Price)
            )
        )
    )
    ; solution
    my_id
    (left_counter left_tail_hash . left_left_tail_hash) ; left slot info
    (right_counter right_tail_hash . right_right_tail_hash) ; right slot info
    (cat_maker_reveal . cat_maker_solution) . ; cat_maker_puzzle_and_solution
    (
        tail_hash ; full TAIL in the reveal of the pre-commit coin
        initial_nft_owner_ph . ; also included in the pre-commit coin
        refund_puzzle_hash_hash ; used to compute precommit coin puzzle hash
    ) ; other_precommit_data 
)
    (include condition_codes.clib)
    (include secure_nft.clib)
    (include slots.clib)

    (defun create_prelauncher_and_assert_launcher (
        NFT_PACK
        my_id
        initial_nft_owner_ph
        prelauncher_full_puzzle_hash
        conditions_so_far
    )
        (c
            (list
                CREATE_COIN
                prelauncher_full_puzzle_hash
                0
            ) ; create uniqueness prelauncher
            (c 
                (secure_nft
                    NFT_PACK
                    initial_nft_owner_ph
                    (coinid 
                        (coinid my_id prelauncher_full_puzzle_hash 0) ; prelauncher id
                        (f (f (f NFT_PACK))) ; launcher puzzle hash
                        1
                    ) ; launcher id
                )
                conditions_so_far
            )
        )
    )

    (defun-inline get_slot_value_hash (counter value left_value right_value)
        (sha256tree (c counter (c value (c left_value right_value))))
    )

    (if (all
        (>s tail_hash left_tail_hash)
        (>s right_tail_hash tail_hash)
        (= (sha256tree cat_maker_reveal) Cat_Maker_Puzzle_Hash)
    )
        (c
            Truth ; nothing changes
            ; create NFT that will hold CAT info
            (create_prelauncher_and_assert_launcher
                NFT_PACK
                my_id
                initial_nft_owner_ph
                (curry_hashes UNIQUENESS_PRELAUNCHER_1ST_CURRY_HASH (sha256 1 tail_hash))
                (list
                    (list ASSERT_MY_COIN_ID my_id)

                    ; announcement
                    (list
                        CREATE_PUZZLE_ANNOUNCEMENT
                        (concat 'r'
                            (sha256tree (c tail_hash initial_nft_owner_ph))
                        ) 
                    )

                    ; spend left slot
                    (spend_slot SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                        (get_slot_value_hash left_counter left_tail_hash left_left_tail_hash right_tail_hash)
                    )
                    ; spend right slot
                    (spend_slot SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                        (get_slot_value_hash right_counter right_tail_hash left_tail_hash right_right_tail_hash)
                    )
                    
                    ; create new slot
                    (create_slot SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                        (get_slot_value_hash 0 tail_hash left_tail_hash right_tail_hash)
                    ) 
                    ; create new left slot
                    (create_slot SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                        (get_slot_value_hash (+ left_counter 1) left_tail_hash left_left_tail_hash tail_hash)
                    ) 
                    ; create new right slot
                    (create_slot SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                        (get_slot_value_hash (+ right_counter 1) right_tail_hash tail_hash right_right_tail_hash)
                    ) 
                    
                    ; consume precommit coin
                    (list
                        SEND_MESSAGE
                        19 ; sender puzzle + receiver puzzle + receiver amount
                        1 ; message = 1 = spend to payout puzzle hash
                        (a
                            cat_maker_reveal
                            (c
                                (curry_hashes PRECOMMIT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                                    refund_puzzle_hash_hash
                                    ; full precommit value reveal is (TAIL . HASH)
                                    ; where HASH = (sha256tree initial_nft_owner_ph cat_maker_hash . cat_maker_solution)
                                    (sha256 2
                                        tail_hash
                                        (sha256 1
                                            (sha256tree (c initial_nft_owner_ph (c Cat_Maker_Puzzle_Hash cat_maker_solution)))
                                        )
                                    )
                                ) ; Inner_Puzzle_Hash
                                cat_maker_solution
                            )
                        ) ; receiver puzzle hash
                        Registration_Price ; receiver amount = precommit_amount = registration fee
                    ) 
                )
            ) ; conditions
        )
        ; else
        (x)
    )
)

b58d77604a610116c93d22a886cf4c76bd79f212.name: --slot_machine-actions-shared-delegated_state
b58d77604a610116c93d22a886cf4c76bd79f212.clvm:
; delegated_state.clsp by yakuhito
;; This action can be used to update the state of the current singleton
;; based on an announcement from another singleton.

;; For example, CAT registration fees might change based on block rewards. It makes sense
;; to have a separate singleton that contains the logic to determine the fee (i.e., schedule)
;; and then have the registration singleton trust it.

(mod (
  SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
  OTHER_SINGLETON_STRUCT_HASH
  (Ephemeral_State . Current_State) ; Truth
  ; solution
  new_state .
  other_singleton_inner_puzzle_hash
)
  (include condition_codes.clib)
  (include sha256tree.clib)
  (include curry.clib)

  (c
    (c Ephemeral_State new_state)
    (list
      (list
        RECEIVE_MESSAGE
        18 ; puzzle-puzzle
        (concat 's' (sha256tree new_state))
        (curry_hashes_inline SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
          OTHER_SINGLETON_STRUCT_HASH
          other_singleton_inner_puzzle_hash
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

6969de3f6e5bbc8a61263cac84d2ffecd6dd0849.name: --slot_machine-actions-xchandles-execute_update
6969de3f6e5bbc8a61263cac84d2ffecd6dd0849.clvm:
; execute_update.clsp by yakuhito
;; After an update is initiated and the appropriate number of blocks have passed,
;; this action can be used to execute the update.

;; Update slot format is (c (c update_initiator_coin_id . min_height) (c handle_hash (c new_owner_launcher_id new_resolved_launcher_id)))

(mod (
    SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
    SINGLETON_LAUNCHER_PUZZLE_HASH
    HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH ; after 1st curry
    UPDATE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH ; after 1st curry
    Truth
    ; solution
    min_execution_height
    (@
        current_slot
        (
            counter .
            (
                (@ handle_and_neighbors (handle_hash . neighbors)) .
                (expiration . (@ current_data (current_owner_launcher_id . current_resolved_launcher_id)))
            )
        )
    )
    (@ new_data (new_owner_launcher_id . new_resolved_launcher_id))
    (current_owner_parent_id current_owner_inner_puzzle_hash . current_owner_amount) .  ; current owner compact coin proof
    (new_owner_inner_puzzle_hash . new_resolved_inner_puzzle_hash) ; new_inner_puzzle_hashes
)
    (include condition_codes.clib)
    (include sha256tree.clib)
    (include xchandles.clib)
    (include curry.clib)
    (include slots.clib)

    (defun singleton_puzzle_hash (SINGLETON_MOD_HASH SINGLETON_LAUNCHER_PUZZLE_HASH launcher_id inner_puzzle_hash)
        (curry_hashes_inline SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
            (sha256tree
                (c SINGLETON_MOD_HASH (c launcher_id SINGLETON_LAUNCHER_PUZZLE_HASH))
            ) ; tree hash of SINGLETON_STRUCT
            inner_puzzle_hash
        )
    )

    (defun consume_messages_and_spend_slot (
        UPDATE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
        update_slot_value_hash
        owner_coin_id
        new_owner_singleton_puzzle_hash
        new_resolved_singleton_puzzle_hash
    )
        (list
            ; assert message from current owner
            (list
                RECEIVE_MESSAGE
                58 ; coin-puzzle
                (concat 'u' update_slot_value_hash)
                owner_coin_id
            )

            ; approval from new owner
            (list
                RECEIVE_MESSAGE
                18 ; puzzle-puzzle
                (concat 'o' update_slot_value_hash)
                new_owner_singleton_puzzle_hash
            )

            ; approval from resolved launcher id
            (list
                RECEIVE_MESSAGE
                18 ; puzzle-puzzle
                (concat 'r' update_slot_value_hash)
                new_resolved_singleton_puzzle_hash
            )

            ; spend update slot
            (spend_slot_inline UPDATE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                update_slot_value_hash
            )
        )
    )

    (c
        Truth
        (c
            ; can't update if expired
            (list ASSERT_BEFORE_SECONDS_ABSOLUTE expiration)
            (c
                ; min_execution_height has passed
                (list ASSERT_HEIGHT_ABSOLUTE min_execution_height)
                (c
                    ; spend handle slot
                    (spend_slot_inline HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH 
                        (sha256tree current_slot)
                    )
                    (c
                        ; create new handle slot
                        (create_slot_inline HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                            (sha256tree (c (+ counter 1) (c handle_and_neighbors (c expiration new_data))))
                        )
                        (consume_messages_and_spend_slot
                            UPDATE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                            ; update slot value hash
                            (sha256tree
                                (c
                                    (c current_owner_parent_id min_execution_height)
                                    (c handle_hash new_data)
                                )
                            )
                            ; initiator coin id
                            (coinid
                                current_owner_parent_id
                                (singleton_puzzle_hash
                                    SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
                                    SINGLETON_LAUNCHER_PUZZLE_HASH
                                    current_owner_launcher_id
                                    current_owner_inner_puzzle_hash
                                )
                                current_owner_amount
                            )
                            ; need approval from new owner and resolved launcher id
                            (singleton_puzzle_hash
                                SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
                                SINGLETON_LAUNCHER_PUZZLE_HASH
                                new_owner_launcher_id
                                new_owner_inner_puzzle_hash
                            )
                            (singleton_puzzle_hash
                                SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
                                SINGLETON_LAUNCHER_PUZZLE_HASH
                                new_resolved_launcher_id
                                new_resolved_inner_puzzle_hash
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    )
)

aebc4387b0847afd2210827c8d5cf6ccfad84235.name: --slot_machine-actions-xchandles-expire
aebc4387b0847afd2210827c8d5cf6ccfad84235.clvm:
; expire.clsp by yakuhito
;; When a handle expires, it goes into an 'auction' where the price is controlled by a puzzle
;;   in the registry's state.

;; Remember that the slot format is (c counter (c (c handle_hash (c left right)) (c expiration (c owner resolved))))

;; Warning: Expired pricing puzzle is responsible for ensuring buy_time > 0

(mod (
    SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
    SINGLETON_LAUNCHER_PUZZLE_HASH
    PRECOMMIT_1ST_CURRY_HASH ; after 1st curry
    HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH ; after 1st curry
    (@ Truth
        (
            Ephemeral_State .
            (@
                Current_State
                (Cat_Maker_Puzzle_Hash Pricing_Puzzle_Hash . Expired_Handle_Pricing_Puzzle_Hash)
            )
        )
    )
    ; solution
    (
        expired_handle_pricing_puzzle_reveal . 
        (@ expired_handle_pricing_puzzle_solution (buy_time current_expiration handle . expired_handle_pricing_puzzle_solution_rest))
    ) ; expired_handle_pricing_puzzle_and_solution
    (cat_maker_puzzle_reveal . cat_maker_puzzle_solution) ; cat_maker_and_solution
    ( 
        (@ new_rest (new_owner_launcher_id . new_resolved_launcher_id)) .
        (refund_puzzle_hash_hash . secret)
    ) ; other_precommit_data
    counter
    neighbors ; (c left right)
    old_rest . ; (c old_owner_launcher_id old_resolved_launcher_id)
    (new_owner_inner_puzzle_hash . new_resolved_inner_puzzle_hash) ; new_inner_puzzle_hashes
)
    (include condition_codes.clib)
    (include sha256tree.clib)
    (include xchandles.clib)
    (include curry.clib)
    (include slots.clib)

    (defun consume_precommit_assert_approvals_and_announce (
        precommit_coin_ph
        total_price
        owner_puzzle_hash
        resolved_puzzle_hash
    )
        (c
            (list
                SEND_MESSAGE
                19 ; sender puzzle + receiver puzzle + receiver amount
                1 ; message = 1 = spend to payout puzzle hash
                precommit_coin_ph
                total_price
            )
            (c 
                (list CREATE_PUZZLE_ANNOUNCEMENT (concat 'x' precommit_coin_ph))
                (c
                    ; get approval from owner
                    (list
                        RECEIVE_MESSAGE
                        18 ; puzzle-puzzle
                        (concat 'e' precommit_coin_ph)
                        owner_puzzle_hash
                    )
                    ; get approval from resolved only if != owner
                    (if (= owner_puzzle_hash resolved_puzzle_hash)
                        ()
                        ; else
                        (c
                            (list
                                RECEIVE_MESSAGE
                                18 ; puzzle-puzzle
                                (concat 'f' precommit_coin_ph)
                                resolved_puzzle_hash
                            )
                            ()
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    )
    
    (defun-inline main (
        handle_hash
        (total_price . registered_time)
    )
        (c
            Truth ; nothing changes
            (c
                (list ASSERT_SECONDS_ABSOLUTE buy_time)
                (c
                    ; assert handle actually expired
                    (list ASSERT_SECONDS_ABSOLUTE current_expiration)
                    (c
                        ; spend slot
                        (spend_slot HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH 
                            (get_xchandles_slot_value_hash counter handle_hash neighbors current_expiration old_rest)
                        )
                        (c
                            ; create new slot
                            (create_slot HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                                (get_xchandles_slot_value_hash (+ counter 1) handle_hash neighbors (+ registered_time buy_time) new_rest)
                            )
                            (consume_precommit_assert_approvals_and_announce
                                (a
                                    cat_maker_puzzle_reveal
                                    (c
                                        (curry_hashes PRECOMMIT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                                            refund_puzzle_hash_hash
                                            (sha256 1 (xchandles_precommitment_value
                                                Cat_Maker_Puzzle_Hash
                                                cat_maker_puzzle_solution
                                                Expired_Handle_Pricing_Puzzle_Hash
                                                expired_handle_pricing_puzzle_solution
                                                handle
                                                secret
                                                new_owner_launcher_id
                                                new_resolved_launcher_id
                                            ))
                                        ) ; Inner_Puzzle_Hash
                                        cat_maker_puzzle_solution
                                    )
                                ) ; precommit coin full puzzle hash
                                total_price ; precommit coin amount
                                (curry_hashes SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
                                    (sha256tree (c SINGLETON_MOD_HASH (c new_owner_launcher_id SINGLETON_LAUNCHER_PUZZLE_HASH)))
                                    new_owner_inner_puzzle_hash
                                )
                                (curry_hashes SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
                                    (sha256tree (c SINGLETON_MOD_HASH (c new_resolved_launcher_id SINGLETON_LAUNCHER_PUZZLE_HASH)))
                                    new_resolved_inner_puzzle_hash
                                )
                            ) ; conditions
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    )

    (if (all
        (= (sha256tree cat_maker_puzzle_reveal) Cat_Maker_Puzzle_Hash)
        (= (sha256tree expired_handle_pricing_puzzle_reveal) Expired_Handle_Pricing_Puzzle_Hash)
        ; Not needed as we receive a message from a singleton having these as launcher ids:
        ; (= (strlen new_owner_launcher_id) 32)
        ; (= (strlen new_resolved_launcher_id) 32)
    )
        (main
            (sha256 1 handle)
            (a expired_handle_pricing_puzzle_reveal expired_handle_pricing_puzzle_solution)
        )
        ; else
        (x)
    )
)

e481e443b5793807a8c1c985bb5e5082d7ad3378.name: --slot_machine-actions-xchandles-extend
e481e443b5793807a8c1c985bb5e5082d7ad3378.clvm:
; extend.clsp by yakuhito
;; Used to extend the registration of a handle

;; Remember that the slot format is (c counter (c (c handle_hash (c left right)) (c expiration (c owner resolved))))
;;  but we're only modifying 'expiration' (and using handle to get correct price factor based on length)

;; Warning: Pricing puzzle is responsible for ensuring registered_time > 0

(mod (
    OFFER_MOD_HASH
    PAYOUT_PUZZLE_HASH
    HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH ; after 1st curry
    (@ Truth
        (
            Ephemeral_State .
            (@
                Current_State
                (Cat_Maker_Puzzle_Hash Pricing_Puzzle_Hash . Expired_Handle_Pricing_Puzzle_Hash)
            )
        )
    )
    ; solution
    (
        pricing_puzzle_reveal .
        (@ pricing_solution (buy_time expiration handle . rest))
    ) ; pricing_puzzle_and_solution
    counter
    neighbors
    rest_data .
    (cat_maker_puzzle_reveal . cat_maker_solution) ; cat_maker_and_solution
)
    (include condition_codes.clib)
    (include sha256tree.clib)
    (include xchandles.clib)
    (include curry.clib)
    (include slots.clib)

    (defun-inline main ((total_price . registered_time))
        (c
            Truth
            (list
                ; spend slot
                (spend_slot_inline HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH 
                    (get_xchandles_slot_value_hash counter (sha256 1 handle) neighbors expiration rest_data)
                )

                ; announcement
                (list CREATE_PUZZLE_ANNOUNCEMENT (concat 'e' (sha256tree (c total_price handle))))
                
                ; can't extend if expired
                (list ASSERT_BEFORE_SECONDS_ABSOLUTE expiration)

                ; assert buy time
                (list ASSERT_SECONDS_ABSOLUTE buy_time)

                ; create new slot
                (create_slot_inline HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                    (get_xchandles_slot_value_hash
                        (+ counter 1)
                        (sha256 1 handle)
                        neighbors
                        (+ expiration registered_time)
                        rest_data
                    )
                ) 
                
                ; assert payment
                (list
                    ASSERT_PUZZLE_ANNOUNCEMENT
                    (sha256
                        (a 
                            cat_maker_puzzle_reveal
                            (c OFFER_MOD_HASH cat_maker_solution)
                        ) ; full CAT puzzle hash
                        (sha256tree 
                            (list
                                (sha256tree (c handle expiration))
                                (list PAYOUT_PUZZLE_HASH total_price (list PAYOUT_PUZZLE_HASH)) ; notarized payment
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            ) ; conditions
        )
    )

    (if (all
        (= Cat_Maker_Puzzle_Hash (sha256tree cat_maker_puzzle_reveal)) ; cat maker puzzle reveal is correct
        (= Pricing_Puzzle_Hash (sha256tree pricing_puzzle_reveal)) ; pricing puzzle reveal is correct
    )
        (main
            (a pricing_puzzle_reveal pricing_solution)
        )
        ; else
        (x)
    )
)

c9d3c14d44443abdba7e260526f1a3637faf98c1.name: --slot_machine-actions-xchandles-initiate_update
c9d3c14d44443abdba7e260526f1a3637faf98c1.clvm:
; initiate_update.clsp by yakuhito
;; An update is a 'rare' process through which the onwer of a record can
;; update the owner_launcher_id and/or resolved_launcher_id of that record

;; To complete the update, the child of the owner coin that initiated the update
;;  needs to finish it after a delay - otherwise, the update is invalidated.

;; Update slot format is (c (c update_initiator_coin_id . min_height) (c handle_hash (c new_owner_launcher_id new_resolved_launcher_id)))

(mod (
    SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
    SINGLETON_LAUNCHER_PUZZLE_HASH
    RELATIVE_BLOCK_HEIGHT ; how many blocks to wait before the update can be executed
    HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH ; after 1st curry
    UPDATE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH ; after 1st curry
    Truth
    ; solution
    (@
        current_slot
        (counter .
            (@
                current_slot_rest
                (
                    (handle_hash . neighbors) .
                    (expiration . (@ current_data (current_owner_launcher_id . current_resolved_launcher_id)))
                )
            )
        )
    )
    (@ new_data (new_owner_launcher_id . new_resolved_launcher_id))
    (current_owner_parent_id current_owner_inner_puzzle_hash . current_owner_amount) . ; current owner compact coin proof
    min_height
)
    (include condition_codes.clib)
    (include sha256tree.clib)
    (include xchandles.clib)
    (include curry.clib)
    (include slots.clib)

    (defun update_slot_value_hash (
        UPDATE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
        update_slot_value_hash
        owner_coin_id
    )
        (list
            ; assert message from current owner
            (list
                RECEIVE_MESSAGE
                58 ; coin-puzzle
                (concat 'i' update_slot_value_hash)
                owner_coin_id
            )

            ; create update slot
            (create_slot_with_hint UPDATE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                update_slot_value_hash
                owner_coin_id
            )
        )
    )

    (defun consume_messages_and_create_slot_stager (
        UPDATE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
        min_execution_height
        update_slot_value_b ; partial update slot value
        owner_coin_id
    )
        (update_slot_value_hash
            UPDATE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
            (sha256tree (c
                (c owner_coin_id min_execution_height)
                update_slot_value_b
            ))
            owner_coin_id
        )
    )

    (c
        Truth
        (c
            ; can't update if expired
            (list ASSERT_BEFORE_SECONDS_ABSOLUTE expiration)
            (c
                ; min_height is in the future
                (list ASSERT_BEFORE_HEIGHT_ABSOLUTE min_height)
                (c
                    ; spend slot
                    (spend_slot HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH 
                        (sha256tree current_slot)
                    )
                    (c
                        ; re-create slot
                        (create_slot HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                            (sha256tree (c (+ counter 1) current_slot_rest))
                        )
                        (consume_messages_and_create_slot_stager
                            UPDATE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                            (+ min_height RELATIVE_BLOCK_HEIGHT)
                            ; update_slot_value_b - partial update slot value
                            (c handle_hash new_data)
                            ; initiator coin id
                            (coinid
                                current_owner_parent_id
                                (curry_hashes SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
                                    (sha256tree
                                        (c SINGLETON_MOD_HASH (c current_owner_launcher_id SINGLETON_LAUNCHER_PUZZLE_HASH))
                                    ) ; tree hash of SINGLETON_STRUCT
                                    current_owner_inner_puzzle_hash
                                )
                                current_owner_amount
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    )
)

aeaf1db2cedb352064f8ff5989cc76cd7024c667.name: --slot_machine-actions-xchandles-oracle
aeaf1db2cedb352064f8ff5989cc76cd7024c667.clvm:
; oracle.clsp by yakuhito
;; Used to 'confirm' a registration on-chain by creating a puzzle announcement

;; The slot format is (c counter (c (c handle_hash (c left right)) (c expiration (c owner resolved))))

(mod (
    HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH ; after 1st curry
    Truth .
    ; solution
    (counter . slot_value_rest) ; solution = slot value :)
)
    (include condition_codes.clib)
    (include sha256tree.clib)
    (include curry.clib)
    (include slots.clib)

    (defun get_conditions (HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH spent_data_treehash created_data_treehash)
        (list
            ; spend slot
            (spend_slot_inline HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH spent_data_treehash)

            ; create new slot
            (create_slot_inline HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH created_data_treehash)

            ; announce value
            (list CREATE_PUZZLE_ANNOUNCEMENT (concat 'o' spent_data_treehash))
        )
    )

    (c
        Truth
        (get_conditions
            HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
            (sha256tree slot_value)
            (sha256tree (c (+ counter 1) slot_value_rest))
        ) ; conditions
    )
)

7009472a5f426554d65a5150e782cc2bb750234e.name: --slot_machine-actions-xchandles-refund
7009472a5f426554d65a5150e782cc2bb750234e.clvm:
; refund.clsp by yakuhito
;; Responsible for returning (i.e., sending back locked value from) invalid precommit coins.

;; A precommit coin is considered invalid if:
;; a) the CAT maker puzzle has changed
;; b) the amount is wrong
;; c) the pricing puzzle has changed
;; d) the handle has already been registered (and the registration is active -i.e., not expired)

(mod (
    PRECOMMIT_1ST_CURRY_HASH ; after 1st curry
    HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH ; after 1st curry
    (@ Truth
        (
            Ephemeral_State .
            (@
                Current_State
                (Cat_Maker_Puzzle_Hash Pricing_Puzzle_Hash . Expired_Handle_Pricing_Puzzle_Hash)
            )
        )
    )
    ; solution
    (
        precommited_pricing_puzzle_reveal_hash
        precommited_pricing_puzzle_reveal .
        precommited_pricing_puzzle_solution
    )
    (
        precommited_cat_maker_reveal_hash
        precommited_cat_maker_reveal .
        precommited_cat_maker_solution
    )
    handle
    precommit_amount ; amount of the pre-commit coin
    (@ slot_value (counter . ((handle_hash . rest1) . (expiration .rest2)))) .
    (
        (precommited_owner_launcher_id . precommited_resolved_launcher_id) .
        (refund_puzzle_hash_hash . secret)
    ) ; other_precommit_data
)
    (include condition_codes.clib)
    (include sha256tree.clib)
    (include xchandles.clib)
    (include curry.clib)
    (include slots.clib)

    (defun main (
        HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
        (@ slot_value (counter . slot_value_part))
        expiration ; () if slot spend is not needed
        precommit_puzzle_hash
        precommit_amount
    )
        (c
            ; consume precommit coin
            (list
                SEND_MESSAGE
                19 ; sender puzzle + receiver puzzle + receiver amount
                0 ; message = 0 = refund
                precommit_puzzle_hash
                precommit_amount
            )
            (c
                ; announcement
                (list
                    CREATE_PUZZLE_ANNOUNCEMENT
                    (concat '$' precommit_puzzle_hash)
                )
                (if expiration
                    (list
                        (list ASSERT_BEFORE_SECONDS_ABSOLUTE expiration)
                        (spend_slot_inline
                            HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                            (sha256tree slot_value)
                        )
                        (create_slot_inline
                            HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                            (sha256tree (c (+ counter 1) slot_value_part))
                        )
                    )
                    ; else
                    ()
                )
            )
        )
    )

    (if (all
        (= precommited_cat_maker_reveal_hash (sha256tree precommited_cat_maker_reveal))
        (= precommited_pricing_puzzle_reveal_hash (sha256tree precommited_pricing_puzzle_reveal))
        (if slot_value (= handle_hash (sha256 1 handle)) 1)
    )
        (c
            Truth
            (main
                HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                slot_value
                (if (all
                        ; not (a)
                        (= precommited_cat_maker_reveal_hash Cat_Maker_Puzzle_Hash)
                        ; not (c)
                        (= handle (f (r (r precommited_pricing_puzzle_solution))))
                        (any
                            (= precommited_pricing_puzzle_reveal_hash Pricing_Puzzle_Hash)
                            (= precommited_pricing_puzzle_reveal_hash Expired_Handle_Pricing_Puzzle_Hash)
                        )
                        ; not (b)
                        (= precommit_amount (f (a precommited_pricing_puzzle_reveal precommited_pricing_puzzle_solution)))
                    ) ; if the precommit coin looks valid after checking (a), (b), (c) & it could be used for registration,
                      ; we must check for (d)
                  (if expiration
                    expiration ; not null
                    ; else
                    (x)
                  )
                  ; else
                  () ; no slot spend needed
                )
                (a
                    precommited_cat_maker_reveal
                    (c
                        (curry_hashes_inline PRECOMMIT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                            refund_puzzle_hash_hash
                            (sha256 1 (xchandles_precommitment_value
                                precommited_cat_maker_reveal_hash
                                precommited_cat_maker_solution
                                precommited_pricing_puzzle_reveal_hash
                                precommited_pricing_puzzle_solution
                                handle
                                secret
                                precommited_owner_launcher_id
                                precommited_resolved_launcher_id
                            )) ; hash of precommit value, which is itself a hash :)
                        ) ; Inner_Puzzle_Hash
                        precommited_cat_maker_solution
                    )
                ) ; receiver puzzle hash
                precommit_amount
            ) ; conditions
        )
        ; else
        (x)
    )
)

6ab156162a60cacb079270033b144ab0d908006e.name: --slot_machine-actions-xchandles-register
6ab156162a60cacb079270033b144ab0d908006e.clvm:
; register.clsp by yakuhito
;; Responsible for registering new handles into the handle registry (XCHandles)

;; Unlike CATalog, a slot's value is (c counter (c (c handle_hash (c left right)) (c expiration (c owner resolved)))) where:
;;  counter is the number of times the slot has been spent
;;  value is the slot 'key'/id and is defined as (sha256 1 handle) / (sha256tree handle)
;;  left_value/right_value are the keys of the slot's neighbors
;;  expiration is a timestamp that says when the handle will expire
;;  owner is a 32-byte launcher id that specifies the owner of the record, who can
;;       update the owner (i.e., transfer the handle) and resolved
;;  resolved is a 32-byte launcher id that points to the singleton containing the resolved data
;;       for XCHandles, for example. resolved may be a 32-byte launcher id of a name NFT
;;       in the future, resolved might point to a namespace/sub-registry, for example

;; Also note that anyone can extend a handle registration, but only the owner can transfer the
;;   record or change the resolved_data

;; Warning: Pricing puzzle is responsible for ensuring registered_time > 0

(mod (
    SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
    SINGLETON_LAUNCHER_PUZZLE_HASH
    PRECOMMIT_1ST_CURRY_HASH ; after 1st curry
    HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH ; after 1st curry
    (@ Truth
        (
            Ephemeral_State .
            (@
                Current_State
                (Cat_Maker_Puzzle_Hash Pricing_Puzzle_Hash . Expired_Handle_Pricing_Puzzle_Hash)
            )
        )
    )
    ; pricing_solution has 3 Truths: Start_Time, Current_Expiration, and Handle_Reveal
    ; solution
    handle_hash
    (@ neighbors (left_value . right_value))
    (cat_maker_puzzle_reveal . cat_maker_solution)
    (pricing_puzzle_reveal . (@ pricing_solution (start_time this_is_zero handle . solution_rest)))
    (left_counter left_left_value left_expiration . left_data)
    (right_counter right_right_value right_expiration . right_data)
    (owner_inner_puzzle_hash . resolved_inner_puzzle_hash) .
    (
        (@ data (owner_launcher_id . resolved_launcher_id)) .
        ; info needed to compute precommit coin puzzle hash
        (refund_puzzle_hash_hash . secret)
    ) ; other_precommit_data
)
    (include condition_codes.clib)
    (include sha256tree.clib)
    (include xchandles.clib)
    (include curry.clib)
    (include slots.clib)

    (defun consume_precommit_assert_approvals_and_announce (
        precommit_puzzle_hash
        precommit_amount
        owner_puzzle_hash
        resolved_puzzle_hash
    )
        (c
            ; consume precommit coin
            (list
                SEND_MESSAGE
                19 ; sender puzzle + receiver puzzle + receiver amount
                1 ; message = 1 = spend to payout puzzle hash
                precommit_puzzle_hash
                precommit_amount
            )
            (c 
                ; announcement
                (list
                    CREATE_PUZZLE_ANNOUNCEMENT
                    (concat 'r' precommit_puzzle_hash)
                )
                (c
                    ; get approval from owner
                    (list
                        RECEIVE_MESSAGE
                        18 ; puzzle-puzzle
                        (concat 'a' precommit_puzzle_hash)
                        owner_puzzle_hash
                    )
                    ; get approval from resolved only if != owner
                    (if (= owner_puzzle_hash resolved_puzzle_hash)
                        ()
                        ; else
                        (c
                            (list
                                RECEIVE_MESSAGE
                                18 ; puzzle-puzzle
                                (concat 'b' precommit_puzzle_hash)
                                resolved_puzzle_hash
                            )
                            ()
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    )

    (defun-inline main ((total_price . registered_time))
        (c
            (list ASSERT_SECONDS_ABSOLUTE start_time)
            (c
                ; spend left slot
                (spend_slot HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH 
                    (get_xchandles_slot_value_hash left_counter left_value (c left_left_value right_value) left_expiration left_data)
                )
                (c
                    ; spend right slot
                    (spend_slot HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                        (get_xchandles_slot_value_hash right_counter right_value (c left_value right_right_value) right_expiration right_data)
                    )
                    (c
                        ; create new slot
                        (create_slot HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                            (get_xchandles_slot_value_hash
                                0
                                handle_hash
                                neighbors
                                (+ start_time registered_time)
                                data
                            )
                        )
                        (c
                            ; create new left slot
                            (create_slot HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH 
                                (get_xchandles_slot_value_hash (+ left_counter 1) left_value (c left_left_value handle_hash) left_expiration left_data)
                            )
                            (c
                                ; create new right slot
                                (create_slot HANDLE_SLOT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                                    (get_xchandles_slot_value_hash (+ right_counter 1) right_value (c handle_hash right_right_value) right_expiration right_data)
                                )
                                (consume_precommit_assert_approvals_and_announce
                                    (a
                                        cat_maker_puzzle_reveal
                                        (c
                                            (curry_hashes PRECOMMIT_1ST_CURRY_HASH
                                                refund_puzzle_hash_hash
                                                (sha256 1 (xchandles_precommitment_value
                                                    Cat_Maker_Puzzle_Hash
                                                    cat_maker_solution
                                                    Pricing_Puzzle_Hash
                                                    pricing_solution
                                                    handle
                                                    secret
                                                    owner_launcher_id
                                                    resolved_launcher_id
                                                ))
                                            ) ; Inner_Puzzle_Hash
                                            cat_maker_solution
                                        )
                                    ) ; precommit_puzzle_hash
                                    total_price ; precommit_amount
                                    (curry_hashes SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
                                        (sha256tree (c SINGLETON_MOD_HASH (c owner_launcher_id SINGLETON_LAUNCHER_PUZZLE_HASH)))
                                        owner_inner_puzzle_hash
                                    )
                                    (curry_hashes SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
                                        (sha256tree (c SINGLETON_MOD_HASH (c resolved_launcher_id SINGLETON_LAUNCHER_PUZZLE_HASH)))
                                        resolved_inner_puzzle_hash
                                    )
                                )
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    )

    (if (all
            (= handle_hash (sha256 1 handle))
            (not this_is_zero) ; Current_Expiry = 0 since handle is being registered
            (>s handle_hash left_value)
            (>s right_value handle_hash)
            (= Cat_Maker_Puzzle_Hash (sha256tree cat_maker_puzzle_reveal)) ; cat maker puzzle reveal is correct
            (= Pricing_Puzzle_Hash (sha256tree pricing_puzzle_reveal)) ; pricing puzzle reveal is correct
            ; These are not needed as we receive a message from a singleton having them:
            ; (= (strlen owner_launcher_id) 32)
            ; (= (strlen resolved_launcher_id) 32)
        )
        (c
            Truth ; new ephemeral state and state
            (main
                (a pricing_puzzle_reveal pricing_solution)
            ) ; conditions
        )
        ; else
        (x)
    )
)

0370e9c0343398cbe3487fb93d4aa24357005cdd.name: --slot_machine-default_puzzles-default_cat_maker
0370e9c0343398cbe3487fb93d4aa24357005cdd.clvm:
; default_cat_maker.clsp by yakuhito
;; Given an inner puzzle and a user-supplied solution, CAT makers return the full puzzle of a CAT
;;   with the given inner puzzle. This allows the registry to support intermediary layers in
;;   future CATs, such as the recently-proposed revocation layer.

;; The default CAT maker assumes no intermediary layers between the CAT outer puzzle and the inner puzzle.

;; Note: Truths (Inner_Puzzle_Hash) are trusted and should be verified by the outer puzzle.

(mod (
    CAT_MOD_HASH
    TAIL_HASH_HASH ; (sha256 1 TAIL_HASH)
    Inner_Puzzle_Hash
    ; Note: other CAT makers may have more arguments here
    ; Puzzles using the maker should prepend Inner_Puzzle_Hash to user-supplied inputs
)
    (include curry.clib)

    (curry_hashes_inline CAT_MOD_HASH
        (sha256 1 CAT_MOD_HASH)
        TAIL_HASH_HASH
        Inner_Puzzle_Hash
    )
)

b54c0f4b73e63e78470366bd4006ca629d94f36c.name: --slot_machine-default_puzzles-exponential_premium
b54c0f4b73e63e78470366bd4006ca629d94f36c.clvm:
; exponential_premium.clsp by yakuhito
;; Expired handles are auctioned off to prevent snipers. This program adds a premium to the
;;   base price of a handle during the auction.

;; This program returns the premium by approximating START_PREMIUM * 0.5^n,
;;   where n is the number of days that have passed since the handle expired.
;; Note that n is fractional - the premium after 1 hour should be START_PREMIUM * 0.5^(1/24).

;; Inspired by ExponentialPremiumPirceOracle: https://github.com/ensdomains/ens-contracts/blob/master/contracts/ethregistrar/ExponentialPremiumPriceOracle.sol

;; Note: Truths (Buy_Time & Expiration) are trusted and should be verified by the outer puzzle.

(mod (
    BASE_PROGRAM ; compute base price using this program
    HALVING_PERIOD ; one day = 86400 = 60 * 60 * 24 seconds
    START_PREMIUM
    END_VALUE ; value returned by the premium function at the end of the reverse auction
              ; to make premium = 0 at the end, we subtract this small value from all
              ;   values returned by the function, effectively moving the graph a bit 
              ;   down on the y-axis so f(auction_end_time) = 0
    PRECISION ; 10 ** 18
    BITS_LIST . ; (list bit1 bit2 bit3 ...)
    (@ solution
        (
            Buy_Time ; 'time now' - assumes user is interested in passing in a value as late as possible
            Current_Expiration
            rest_of_pricing_program_solution ; pricing_program_solution passed to BASE_PROGRAM (e.g., (Handle . num_periods))
        )
    )
)
    (defun add_fractional_part (PRECISION bits_list acc fraction_part premium)
        (if bits_list
            (add_fractional_part
                PRECISION
                (r bits_list)
                (lsh acc 1)
                fraction_part
                (if (logand fraction_part acc)
                    (/ (* premium (f bits_list)) PRECISION)
                    ; else
                    premium
                )
            )
            ; else
            premium
        )
    )

    ; if premium is lower than END_VALUE, auction's over
    (defun correct_premium (premium END_VALUE)
        (if (> premium END_VALUE) (- premium END_VALUE) 0)
    )

    (defun-inline main ((price_without_premium . registered_time))
        (c
            (+
                price_without_premium
                (correct_premium (add_fractional_part
                   PRECISION
                   BITS_LIST
                   1
                   (/ (* 65536 (% (- Buy_Time Current_Expiration) HALVING_PERIOD)) HALVING_PERIOD) ; fractional part of n with 16 bits of precision (2 ** 16 = 65536)
                   (/ START_PREMIUM (lsh 1 (/ (- Buy_Time Current_Expiration) HALVING_PERIOD))) ; premium from whole periods = START_PREMIUM / 2^p
                ) END_VALUE) ; premium
            )
            registered_time
        )
    )

    (main
        (a BASE_PROGRAM solution)
    )
)

8f32b677752a2ad131890f6ef723af3b8b763b13.name: --slot_machine-default_puzzles-factor_pricing
8f32b677752a2ad131890f6ef723af3b8b763b13.clvm:
; factor_pricing.clsp by yakuhito
;; Price a handle based on the number of characters it has. Inspired by ENS.

;; This is a pricing program and will return (price . registered_time) where 
;;  price is the total price of the handle and registered_time is the time
;;  that the user will own the handle for (e.g., 1 year, 2 years, and so on).

;; The price is determined by multiplying the base price by a factor. The factor is as follows:
;; - 6+ characters with no numbers: 2
;; - 5 characters with no numbers: 16
;; - 4 characters with no numbers: 64
;; - 3 characters with no numbers: 128
;; If the handle contains a number, the price is halved.

;; Note: Truths (Buy_Time, Current_Expiration, Handle) are trusted and should be verified by the outer puzzle.

(mod (
    BASE_PRICE ; base price = price per month of a 6+ character handle with at least one number
    REGISTRATION_PERIOD ; number of seconds to register a handle for, in seconds
                        ; most likely 31622400 = 366 days * 24 hours/day * 60 minutes/hour * 60 seconds/minute
    Buy_Time ; 'time now' - assumes user is interested in passing in a value as late as possible
             ; This Truth is unused in this puzzle, but can be used to price handles differently
             ; Generally, the outer puzzle will just verify it with an ASSERT_SECONDS_ABSOLUTE
             ;   but with no matching ASSERT_BEFORE_SECONDS_ABSOLUTE & delay
    Current_Expiration ; 0 if the handle is being registered, != 0 if extension
                       ; this Truth is unused in this puzzle, but can be used to price renewals differently
                       ;   in custom ones
    Handle .
    num_periods ; number of periods to register the handle for (e.g., 1 year, 2 years, and so on)
)
    (defun get_price_factor (length number_of_numbers)
        (/
            (if (> length 2)
                (i (> length 4)
                    (i (= length 5)
                        16
                        ; else length >= 6
                        (if (> length 63) (x) 2)
                    )
                    ; else 2 < length < 5
                    (i (= length 3)
                        128
                        ; else length = 4
                        (q . 64)
                    )
                )
                ; else length <= 2
                (x)
            )
            (i number_of_numbers 2 1) ; halve the price if handle contains numbers
        )
    )

    (defun single_char_helper (ch rest)
        (if (all (> ch (- "a" 1)) (> (+ "z" 1) ch)) ; letter (a-z)
            (count_numbers_plus_validate rest)
            ; else
            (if (all (> ch (- "0" 1)) (> (+ "9" 1) ch)) ; digit (0-9)
                (+ 1 (count_numbers_plus_validate rest))
                ; else
                (x) ; invalid character in handle
            )
        )
    )

    ;; this function will return the number of numbers in a handle
    ;; PLUS it will (x) if the handle contains invalid characters
    (defun count_numbers_plus_validate (handle)
        (if handle
            (single_char_helper (substr handle 0 1) (substr handle 1))
            ; else
            0
        )
    )

    ; main
    (if (> num_periods 0)
        (c 
            (* num_periods BASE_PRICE (get_price_factor (strlen Handle) (count_numbers_plus_validate Handle)))
            (* num_periods REGISTRATION_PERIOD)
        )
        ; else
        (x)
    )
)

040753f82d91f7d6640cbd1ca0a53a5988a42380.name: --slot_machine-default_puzzles-revocable_cat_maker
040753f82d91f7d6640cbd1ca0a53a5988a42380.clvm:
; revocable_cat_maker.clsp by yakuhito
;; Given an inner puzzle and a user-supplied solution, CAT makers return the full puzzle of a CAT
;;   with the given inner puzzle. This allows the registry to support intermediary layers in
;;   future CATs, such as the recently-proposed revocation layer.

;; The revocable CAT maker assumes the revocation layer is the only layer separating the CAT outer puzzle
;;   from the inner puzzle.

;; Note: Truths (Inner_Puzzle_Hash) are trusted and should be verified by the outer puzzle.

(mod (
    (CAT_MOD_HASH REVOCATION_LAYER_MOD_HASH . HIDDEN_PUZZLE_HASH_HASH)
    TAIL_HASH_HASH ; (sha256 1 TAIL_HASH)
    Inner_Puzzle_Hash
    ; Note: other CAT makers may have more arguments here
    ; Puzzles using the maker should prepend Inner_Puzzle_Hash to a user-supplied input
)
    (include curry.clib)

    (curry_hashes_inline CAT_MOD_HASH
        (sha256 1 CAT_MOD_HASH)
        TAIL_HASH_HASH
        (curry_hashes_inline REVOCATION_LAYER_MOD_HASH
            (sha256 1 REVOCATION_LAYER_MOD_HASH)
            HIDDEN_PUZZLE_HASH_HASH
            (sha256 1 Inner_Puzzle_Hash)
        ) ; CAT layer inner puzzle
    )
)

9f28d55242a3bd2b3661c38ba8647392c26bb865.name: --slot_machine-nft-any_metadata
9f28d55242a3bd2b3661c38ba8647392c26bb865.clvm:
; any_metadata.clsp by yakuhito
;; Allows an NFT owner to fully control the metadata of an NFT they own

;; Note that the metadata updater may not be changed, and no extra conditions
;; will be added (to prevent potential bypasses of e.g., ownership layer).

(mod
  (
    Current_Metadata
    Metadata_Updater_Puzzle_Hash
    new_metadata ; provided by owner/inner puzzle
  )
  ; returns ((new_metadata new_metadata_updater_puzhash) conditions)
  (list (list new_metadata Metadata_Updater_Puzzle_Hash) ())
)

851c3d39cef84cfd9449afcaeff5f50d1be9371d.name: --slot_machine-nft-uniqueness_prelauncher
851c3d39cef84cfd9449afcaeff5f50d1be9371d.clvm:
; uniqueness_prelauncher.clsp by yakuhito
;; Allows easy verification that a singleton was created by another singleton to represent a value
;; e.g., To prove that an NFT presents info relating to an asset id, one can (either off-chain or in clsp)
;;  use the launcher id. The launcher parent should be validated to be a generation of the CAT registration
;;  singleton, the puzzle should contain the asset id as VALUE, and the amount should be 0.

;; Note: Create this coin with an amount of 0.

(mod (
  ; 1st curry
  LAUNCHER_PH
  ; 2nd curry
  VALUE
)
  (include condition_codes.clib)

  (list
    (list CREATE_COIN LAUNCHER_PH 1)
    (list CREATE_PUZZLE_ANNOUNCEMENT VALUE)
  )
)

4123ac61065a5ef51bf2acc1721f07566083b3e1.name: --slot_machine-singleton-action
4123ac61065a5ef51bf2acc1721f07566083b3e1.clvm:
; action.clsp by yakuhito
;; Inner puzzle for a singleton that has a state and may run any of n actions
;; Each action will receive the current state + an ephemeral state and return new values
;; One or more actions may be run per spend

;; An action's solution will always be: (c (c Ephemeral_State Current_State) solution)
;;    (where capital first letters are used to denote Truths)
;; It returns three values: ((new_ephemeral_state . new_state) . new_conditions)
;;    state is passed from one action to the next and the latest value is saved between spends
;;        (it is persistent)
;;    ephemeral_state is not persistent - it's () for the first action of any new spend
;;        but passed from the previous action in the same spend
;;    new_conditions will be directly added to this puzzle's output conditions
;;    but the finalizer puzzle is able to filter them after all actions are run

;; Warning: This puzzle's finalizer likely assumes the singleton's amount is 1 (like the default one does).

(mod (
    FINALZIER
    MERKLE_ROOT
    STATE
    puzzles
    selectors_and_proofs ; (list (selector . proof) ...) INVERSE ORDER
    solutions . ; (list (action_solution ...)
    finalizer_solution
)
    (include merkle_utils.clib)
    (include sha256tree.clib)

    (defun item_in_list (the_item (@ the_list (first_item . remaining_list)))
        (if (= the_item first_item)
            1
            (item_in_list the_item remaining_list)
        )
    )

    (defun reduce_and_verify_proofs (
        MERKLE_ROOT
        puzzles
        selectors_so_far
        (@ pending_selectors_and_proofs ((selector . proof) . remaining_pending_selectors_and_proofs))
    )
        (if pending_selectors_and_proofs
            (if
                (if proof
                    (= MERKLE_ROOT (simplify_merkle_proof (sha256tree (a selector puzzles)) proof))
                    ; else
                    (item_in_list selector selectors_so_far)
                )
                (reduce_and_verify_proofs
                    MERKLE_ROOT
                    puzzles
                    (c selector selectors_so_far)
                    remaining_pending_selectors_and_proofs
                )
                ; else
                (x)
            )
            ; else
            selectors_so_far
        )
    )

    (defun run_actions (
        puzzles
        current_conditions
        (ephemeral_and_actual_state . new_conditions)
        (@ pending_selectors (selector . remaining_selectors))
        (@ pending_solutions (solution . remaining_solutions))
    )
        (if pending_selectors
            (run_actions
                puzzles
                (c new_conditions current_conditions)
                (a (a selector puzzles) (c ephemeral_and_actual_state solution))
                remaining_selectors
                remaining_solutions
            )
            ; else
            (c
                ephemeral_and_actual_state
                (c new_conditions current_conditions)
            )
        )
    )
    
    (if selectors_and_proofs
        (a
            FINALZIER
            (c
                (c MERKLE_ROOT STATE)
                (c
                    (run_actions
                        puzzles
                        ()
                        (list (c () STATE))
                        (reduce_and_verify_proofs MERKLE_ROOT puzzles () selectors_and_proofs)
                        solutions
                    )
                    finalizer_solution
                )
            )
        )
        ; else - do not allow spends with no actions called
        (x)
    )
)

5ec944c72fd72b55f7c753f4ded0f3fe7387958f.name: --slot_machine-singleton-finalizer
5ec944c72fd72b55f7c753f4ded0f3fe7387958f.clvm:
; finalizer.clsp by yakuhito
;; This puzzle is essentially used in the singleton action layer to 'finalize' a set of actions
;; The current one only re-creates the singleton, but advanced dApps could use it to create other
;;  conditions based on the final state - e.g., re-create the singleton's reserves or modify merkle root

;; Note: This finalizer assumes sets the next singleton's amount to 1.

(mod (
    ACTION_LAYER_MOD_HASH
    HINT
    ; 2nd curry
    FINALIZER_SELF_HASH
    (
        Merkle_Root . 
        Initial_State ; not used for this puzzle
    ) ; Truth
    ((Last_Ephemeral_State . New_State) . Conditions) . ; last action output
    my_solution ; not used here
)
    (include condition_codes.clib)
    (include sha256tree.clib)
    (include curry.clib)

    (defun flatten_list (((@ first_thing (first_cond . remaining_conds)) . the_rest))
        (if first_thing
            (c first_cond (flatten_list (c remaining_conds the_rest)))
            ; else
            (if the_rest
                (flatten_list the_rest)
                ; else
                ()
            )
        )
    )

    (c
        (list
            CREATE_COIN
            (curry_hashes ACTION_LAYER_MOD_HASH
                (curry_hashes FINALIZER_SELF_HASH
                    (sha256 1 FINALIZER_SELF_HASH)
                ) ; finalizer puzzle hash
                (sha256 1 Merkle_Root)
                (sha256tree New_State)
            ) ; new inner ph
            1
            (list HINT)
        )
        (flatten_list Conditions)
    )
)

57d1db4000b7123a3f0a79d56a0db69c65b897f7.name: --slot_machine-singleton-p2_delegated_by_singleton
57d1db4000b7123a3f0a79d56a0db69c65b897f7.clvm:
; https://github.com/greimela/chia-blockchain/blob/721b32003f455ace14a735554ee0f83092ef1265/chia/wallet/revocable_cats/p2_delegated_by_singleton.clsp
; This puzzle is used to delegate a spend to a singleton.
; The singleton will authorize the spend by sending a message via the SEND_MESSAGE condition.
(mod (
        SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
        SINGLETON_STRUCT_HASH ; The hash of (SINGLETON_MOD_HASH . (LAUNCHER_ID . SINGLETON_LAUNCHER_HASH))
        NONCE
        singleton_inner_puzzle_hash
        delegated_puzzle .
        delegated_solution
    )

    (include condition_codes.clib)
    (include curry.clib)
    (include sha256tree.clib)

    (defun-inline calculate_full_puzzle_hash (SINGLETON_MOD_HASH SINGLETON_STRUCT_HASH inner_puzzle_hash)
        (curry_hashes_inline SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
            SINGLETON_STRUCT_HASH
            inner_puzzle_hash
        )
    )

    (c
        (list RECEIVE_MESSAGE
            23 ; = 010 111, mask for puzzle hash to coin ID
            (sha256tree delegated_puzzle)
            (calculate_full_puzzle_hash SINGLETON_MOD_HASH SINGLETON_STRUCT_HASH singleton_inner_puzzle_hash)
        )
        (a delegated_puzzle delegated_solution)
    )
)

b5a39f8d4803f840e15f0f0304fd5b605cb7c68a.name: --slot_machine-singleton-precommit
b5a39f8d4803f840e15f0f0304fd5b605cb7c68a.clvm:
; precommit.clsp by yakuhito
;; A pre-commit coin can be used to prove that a value has been pre-committed for a singleton
;;  some time ago

(mod (
        ; 1st curry
        SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
        SINGLETON_STRUCT_HASH ; owner/controller singleton
        RELATIVE_BLOCK_HEIGHT ; how many blocks to wait before this coin is spendable
        PAYOUT_PUZZLE_HASH ; where the funds go if message=1 (use precommit to do something)
        ; 2nd curry
        REFUND_PUZZLE_HASH ; where the funds go if message=0 (refund)
        VALUE
        spend_mode ; 0 = refund, 1 = spend to payout puzzle hash
        my_amount .
        ; info about this coin's spender (singleton coin being spent)
        singleton_inner_puzzle_hash
    )

    (include condition_codes.clib)
    (include curry.clib)

    (list 
        (list ASSERT_HEIGHT_RELATIVE RELATIVE_BLOCK_HEIGHT)
        (list ASSERT_MY_AMOUNT my_amount)
        (list
            CREATE_COIN
            (i spend_mode PAYOUT_PUZZLE_HASH REFUND_PUZZLE_HASH)
            my_amount
            (list (i spend_mode PAYOUT_PUZZLE_HASH REFUND_PUZZLE_HASH))
        )
        (list
            RECEIVE_MESSAGE
            19 ; sender puzzle + receiver puzzle + receiver amount
            spend_mode ; message
            (curry_hashes SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
                SINGLETON_STRUCT_HASH
                singleton_inner_puzzle_hash
            )
        )
    )
)

e8846034e2d2c23fb35ed07847d02e7e8236fb99.name: --slot_machine-singleton-reserve_finalizer
e8846034e2d2c23fb35ed07847d02e7e8236fb99.clvm:
; reserve_finalizer.clsp by yakuhito

;; Reserve finalizer - does everything the normal finalizer does, but also
;;   manages a reserve whose amount is the first item in the state

;; Reserve output conditions can be added by any action by prepending them with
;;   -42 (i.e., (c -42 condition) will add 'condition' to the list of output conditions)

;; This puzzle handles reserve re-creation based on the new state

(mod (
      ACTION_LAYER_MOD_HASH
      RESERVE_FULL_PUZZLE_HASH
      RESERVE_INNER_PUZZLE_HASH
      RESERVE_AMOUNT_FROM_STATE_PROGRAM ; default is 02 - i.e., (f State)
      HINT
      ; 2nd curry
      FINALIZER_SELF_HASH
      (
        Merkle_Root .
        Initial_State ; used to extract current reserve amount
      ) ; Truth
      ((Last_Ephemeral_State . New_State) . Conditions) . ; last action output
      reserve_parent_id ; my_solution
)
    (include condition_codes.clib)
    (include sha256tree.clib)
    (include curry.clib)

    ; this function will extract conditions for the reserve coin which are (-42 . ACTUAL_CONDITION)
    (defun parse_conditions (
        (
            (@
                first_thing
                ((@ first_cond (opcode . condition)) . remaining_conditions)
            ) . the_rest
        )
        conditions
        extracted_reserve_conditions
    )
        (if first_thing
            (if (= opcode -42)
                (parse_conditions (c remaining_conditions the_rest) conditions (c condition extracted_reserve_conditions))
                ; else
                (parse_conditions (c remaining_conditions the_rest) (c first_cond conditions) extracted_reserve_conditions)
            )
            ; else
            (if the_rest
                (parse_conditions the_rest conditions extracted_reserve_conditions)
                ; else
                (c conditions extracted_reserve_conditions)
            )
        )
    )

    (defun-inline add_message_to_reserve ((base_conditions . reserve_conditions))
        (c
            (list SEND_MESSAGE
                23 ; sender puzzle hash, receiver coin id
                (sha256tree (c ; this is the leading 'q . ' in the delegated puzzle
                    1 
                    (c
                        (list
                            CREATE_COIN
                            RESERVE_INNER_PUZZLE_HASH
                            (a RESERVE_AMOUNT_FROM_STATE_PROGRAM New_State)
                            (list RESERVE_INNER_PUZZLE_HASH)
                        )
                        reserve_conditions
                    )
                )) ; message = delegated puzzle hash
                (coinid
                    reserve_parent_id
                    RESERVE_FULL_PUZZLE_HASH
                    (a RESERVE_AMOUNT_FROM_STATE_PROGRAM Initial_State) ; total_reserves
                )
            )
            base_conditions
        )
    )

    (c
        (list
            CREATE_COIN
            (curry_hashes ACTION_LAYER_MOD_HASH
                (curry_hashes FINALIZER_SELF_HASH 
                    (sha256 1 FINALIZER_SELF_HASH)
                ) ; finalizer puzzle hash
                (sha256 1 Merkle_Root)
                (sha256tree New_State)
            ) ; new inner ph
            1
            (list HINT)
        )
        (add_message_to_reserve (parse_conditions Conditions () ()))
    )
)

27de4bb4bc5c6881c08e7e57288e2b855d934fd6.name: --slot_machine-singleton-slot
27de4bb4bc5c6881c08e7e57288e2b855d934fd6.clvm:
; slot.clsp by yakuhito
;; A singleton slot coin is created to store values that may be read at a later spend
;; To read the values, the singleton will spend the slot coin - so the values are only readable once
;; Might be helpful to think of this as a one-time ticket

;; Double currying allows the controller singleton to only care about the 1st curry hash, which means it
;;   only needs that and VALUE_HASH to build the full slot puzzle hash. This leads to more cost saved.
;; NONCE is used to differentiate between slot types - it avoids situations where slots representing
;;   two separate things but that hold the same value format (e.g., list of 3 numbers) can be confused.

;; Warning: Slots do not assure uniqueness - a double-linked sorted list structure on top is required for that
;;          An attacker might intentionally omit a given slot to trick the dApp that it doesn't exist
;;          For example, a naive handle reigstration app might be tricked into registering the same handle twice

(mod (
      ; 1st curry
      (@ CONTROLLER_SINGLETON_INFO (
        SINGLETON_MOD_HASH .
        SINGLETON_STRUCT_HASH ; treehash of owner/controller singleton struct
      ))
      NONCE ; different nonces will hold different data types
      ; 2nd curry
      VALUE_HASH
      ; info about this coin's parent (previous singleton coin)
      (parent_parent_info parent_inner_puzzle_hash . parent_amount) . ; compact lineage proof
      ; info about this coin's spender (current singleton coin - the one consuming the value)
      spender_inner_puzzle_hash
)

    (include condition_codes.clib)
    (include sha256tree.clib)
    (include curry.clib)

    (defun singleton_full_puzzle_hash ((SINGLETON_MOD_HASH . SINGLETON_STRUCT_HASH) inner_puzzle_hash)
        (curry_hashes_inline SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
            SINGLETON_STRUCT_HASH
            inner_puzzle_hash
        )
    )

    (list 
        (list ASSERT_MY_PARENT_ID
            (coinid
                parent_parent_info
                (singleton_full_puzzle_hash CONTROLLER_SINGLETON_INFO parent_inner_puzzle_hash)
                parent_amount
            )
        )
        (list
            RECEIVE_MESSAGE
            18 ; puzzle-puzzle
            ()
            (singleton_full_puzzle_hash CONTROLLER_SINGLETON_INFO spender_inner_puzzle_hash)
        )
    )
)

13fe7833751a6fe582caa09d48978d8d1b016d22.name: --slot_machine-singleton-state_scheduler
13fe7833751a6fe582caa09d48978d8d1b016d22.clvm:
; state_scheduler.clsp by yakuhito
;; Used as the inner puzzle of a singleton that schedules state changes for another singleton.
;; Once 'committed' to a state schedule, the price singleton (which is really the state scheduler singleton)
;;   has to abide it, with the * that states may come into effect later than scheduled if users don't spend
;;   the scheduler on time.

;; For an example, see actions/shared/delegated_state.clsp (this is the trusted singleton).

(mod (
    SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
    RECEIVER_SINGLETON_STRUCT_HASH
    MESSAGE
    INNER_PUZZLE
    other_singleton_inner_puzzle_hash .
    inner_solution
)
    (include condition_codes.clib)
    (include curry.clib)

    (c
        (list
            SEND_MESSAGE
            18 ; puzzle-puzzle
            MESSAGE
            (curry_hashes_inline SINGLETON_MOD_HASH
                RECEIVER_SINGLETON_STRUCT_HASH
                other_singleton_inner_puzzle_hash
            )
        )
        (a INNER_PUZZLE inner_solution)
    )
)

cd2caba380e2bb21e209f8b5cad9d832a20bec53.name: --slot_machine-verification-catalog_verification_maker
cd2caba380e2bb21e209f8b5cad9d832a20bec53.clvm:
(mod (
    VERIFICATION_INNER_PUZZLE_SELF_HASH
    VERSION
    ASSET_ID_HASH
    DATA_HASH_HASH ; verification 'locked params'
    comment ; verifier free to comment anything
)
    (include curry.clib)
    (include sha256tree.clib)

    (curry_hashes_inline VERIFICATION_INNER_PUZZLE_SELF_HASH
        (sha256 1 VERIFICATION_INNER_PUZZLE_SELF_HASH) ; SELF_HASH
        (sha256 2
            (sha256 1 VERSION)
            (sha256 2 ASSET_ID_HASH
                (sha256 2 DATA_HASH_HASH (sha256 1 comment))
