aacce7b99db5b1e9eb16d676fa5f1a2e469ef589.name: --chip_0037-p2_eip712_message
aacce7b99db5b1e9eb16d676fa5f1a2e469ef589.clvm:
; p2_eip712_message.clsp by yakuhito
;; A replacement for the standard puzzle allowing coins to be controlled by EIP-712 messages

;; The EIP-712 domain contains:
;;   - name to be dislayed when signing ("Chia Coin Spend")
;;   - version ("1")
;;   - salt (32-byte genesis challenge of the testnet11/mainnet Chia network)
;; The domain separator can then be computed off-chain as follows:
;; bytes32 domainSeparator = keccak256(abi.encode(
;;    keccak256("EIP712Domain(string name,string version,bytes32 salt)"),
;;    keccak256(bytes("Chia Coin Spend")),
;;    keccak256(bytes("1")),
;;    salt
;; ));

;; We can also compute type hash as:
;; bytes32 typeHash = keccak256("ChiaCoinSpend(bytes32 coin_id,bytes32 delegated_puzzle_hash)");

;; Per the EIP-712 spec, the hash that is actually signed can be obtained as:
;; bytes32 messageHash = keccak256(abi.encode(
;;     typeHash,
;;     coin_id,
;;     delegated_puzzle_hash
;; ));
;; bytes32 hashToSign = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(
;;     "\x19\x01",
;;     domainSeparator,
;;     messageHash
;; ));

;; Also note how awesome it is that we're passing bytes32 values to abi.encode, so we don't
;; have to worry about padding.

(mod (
    PREFIX_AND_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR
    TYPE_HASH
    PUBKEY
    my_id
    signed_hash
    signature
    delegated_puzzle
    delegated_solution
)
    (include condition_codes.clib)
    (include sha256tree.clib)

    (if (all
        (not (secp256k1_verify PUBKEY signed_hash signature))
        ; https://github.com/Chia-Network/chips/blob/main/CHIPs/chip-0011.md#softfork-usage
        (not (softfork
            (q . 2745) ; total cost needed to run the code + 140 = 2605 + 140 = 2745 
            (q . 1) ; keccak256 soft fork
            (mod
                (PREFIX_AND_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR TYPE_HASH my_id delegated_puzzle_hash signed_hash)
                (if (= (keccak256 PREFIX_AND_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR (keccak256 TYPE_HASH my_id delegated_puzzle_hash)) signed_hash) () (x))
            ) ; code to evaluate
            (list
                PREFIX_AND_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR
                TYPE_HASH
                my_id
                (sha256tree delegated_puzzle)
                signed_hash
            ) ; environment
        ))
    )
        (c
           (list ASSERT_MY_COIN_ID my_id)
           (a delegated_puzzle delegated_solution)
        )
        ; else
        (x)
    )
)

d5415713619e318bfa7820e06e2b163beef32d82.name: --chip_0037-p2_controller_puzzle
d5415713619e318bfa7820e06e2b163beef32d82.clvm:
; p2_controller_puzzle_hash.clsp by yakuhito
;; Used to lock coins that can only be controlled by a specific puzzle hash

;; This is also the best way to make wallets need one signature for virtually any spend (thanks, Rigidity!)
;; Use the EIP-712/passkey puzzle as controller puzzle, and lock all coins in the wallet with this one
;; One of them can create the controller as their child, which is even cooler 

(mod (
    CONTROLLER_PUZZLE_HASH
    delegated_puzzle
    delegated_solution
)
    (include condition_codes.clib)
    (include sha256tree.clib)

    (c
        (list
            RECEIVE_MESSAGE
            23 ; 010111 = puzzle hash - coin
            (sha256tree delegated_puzzle) ; message is delegated puzzle hash
            CONTROLLER_PUZZLE_HASH
        )
        (a delegated_puzzle delegated_solution)
    )
)

e0e312a612aa14357e225c0dc21d351610c2377e.name: --streaming-stream
e0e312a612aa14357e225c0dc21d351610c2377e.clvm:
; stream.clsp by yakuhito

;; Used to 'stream' CATs/XCH to a user over time.

(mod (
    RECIPIENT
    CLAWBACK_PH
    END_TIME
    ; 2nd curry
    SELF_HASH
    LAST_PAYMENT_TIME
    my_amount
    payment_time
    to_pay .
    clawback
)
    (include condition_codes.clsp)
    (include curry.clsp)

    (if (= to_pay (/ (* my_amount (- payment_time LAST_PAYMENT_TIME)) (- END_TIME LAST_PAYMENT_TIME)))
        (list
            (list ASSERT_MY_AMOUNT my_amount)
            (i clawback 
                (list ASSERT_BEFORE_SECONDS_ABSOLUTE payment_time)
                ; else
                (list ASSERT_SECONDS_ABSOLUTE payment_time)
            )
            (i (= to_pay ())
                (list REMARK)
                ; else
                (list CREATE_COIN RECIPIENT to_pay (list RECIPIENT))
            )
            (i (= my_amount to_pay)
                (list REMARK)
                ; else
                (list
                    CREATE_COIN
                    (i clawback
                        CLAWBACK_PH
                        ; else
                        (curry_hashes_inline SELF_HASH
                            (sha256 1 SELF_HASH)
                            (sha256 1 payment_time)
                        )
                    )
                    (- my_amount to_pay)
                    (list (sha256 's' RECIPIENT))
                )
            )
            (list
                RECEIVE_MESSAGE
                23 ; sender puzzle hash, receiver coin id
                payment_time ; message
                (i clawback CLAWBACK_PH RECIPIENT) ; sender puzzle hash
            )
        )
        ; else
        (x)
    )
)

407f70ea751c25052708219ae148b45db2f61af2.name: --dig_datalayer-writer_filter
407f70ea751c25052708219ae148b45db2f61af2.clvm:
; writer_filter.clsp
; for DataLayer.storage by yakuhito

;; Allows the data store owner to add writers that:
;;  - CAN update the store root hash, label, description, and any other metadata
;;    (i.e., call the metadata updatter via the -24 condition)
;;  - CANNOT update the authorized puzzles list
;;    (i.e., cannot use the -13 condition)


(mod (
    INNER_PUZZLE
    inner_solution
  )

  (defun morph_conditions (conditions)
    (if conditions
      (if (= (f (f conditions)) -13) ; don't allow updating merkle root
        (x)
        ; else
        (c (f conditions) (morph_conditions (r conditions)))
      )
      ; else - all conditions checked
      ()
    )
  )

  (morph_conditions (a INNER_PUZZLE inner_solution))
)

c3b249466cb15c51e5abb5c54ef5077c1624ae2e.name: --dig_datalayer-delegation_layer
c3b249466cb15c51e5abb5c54ef5077c1624ae2e.clvm:
; delegation_layer.clsp
; for DataLayer.storage by yakuhito

;; Allows the owner of a store to delegate a fixed set of capabilities to
;; other puzzle hashes.
;; This layer will re-create itself when a delegated puzzle is running to 
;; prevent take-over attacks.
;; Capabilities can be further restricted via filters.

;; Warning: This puzzle only works for the default data layer metadata updater (11).
;; Warning: If multiple -13 conditions are emitted, the last one will be used to determine the new Merkle root.
;;          This layer will *NOT* raise in the case above.

(mod (
    MOD_HASH
    LAUNCHER_ID
    INNER_PUZZLE_HASH
    MERKLE_ROOT
    merkle_proof ; () if running inner puzzle
    puzzle_reveal
    puzzle_solution
  )

  (include condition_codes.clib)
  (include merkle_utils.clib)
  (include sha256tree.clib)
  (include curry.clib)

  (defconstant NEW_MERKLE_ROOT_CONDITION -13)

  ; only one odd CREATE_COIN enforced in upper layers
  (defun morph_conditions (MOD_HASH LAUNCHER_ID INNER_PUZZLE_HASH conditions new_merkle_root_info)
    (if conditions
      (if (= (f (f conditions)) NEW_MERKLE_ROOT_CONDITION)
        (morph_conditions
          MOD_HASH LAUNCHER_ID INNER_PUZZLE_HASH
          (r conditions)
          (r (f conditions))
        )
        ; else
        (c
          ; don't allow delegated puzzles to use the metadata updater to create extra conditions
          ; or to change the metadata updater puzzle hash
          ; update metadata condition is (list -24 [metadata updater puzzle reveal] [solution])
          ; for the standard DL, solution is (list (list [new metadata] [new updater ph]) [conditions])
          (if
            (if (= (f (f conditions)) -24)
              (all
                ; raise if condition is -24 but [conditions] != 0
                (= (f (r (f (r (r (f conditions)))))) ())
                ; or raise if condition is -24 and [new updater ph] != (sha256 1 11)
                (= (f (r (f (f (r (r (f conditions))))))) (sha256 1 11))
              )
              ; else
              1
            )
            (f conditions)
            ; else
            (x)
          )
          (morph_conditions
            MOD_HASH LAUNCHER_ID INNER_PUZZLE_HASH
            (r conditions)
            new_merkle_root_info
          )
        )
      )
      ; else
      (list
        (list
          CREATE_COIN
          (curry_hashes_inline MOD_HASH
            (sha256 1 MOD_HASH)
            (sha256 1 LAUNCHER_ID)
            (sha256 1 INNER_PUZZLE_HASH)
            (sha256 1 (f new_merkle_root_info))
          )
          1
          (r new_merkle_root_info)
        )
      )
    )
  )

 (defun main (MOD_HASH LAUNCHER_ID INNER_PUZZLE_HASH MERKLE_ROOT merkle_proof conditions puzzle_hash)
    (if (= puzzle_hash INNER_PUZZLE_HASH)
      conditions
      ; else
      (if (= MERKLE_ROOT (simplify_merkle_proof puzzle_hash merkle_proof))
        (morph_conditions
          MOD_HASH
          LAUNCHER_ID
          INNER_PUZZLE_HASH
          conditions
          (list MERKLE_ROOT LAUNCHER_ID) 
        )
        ; else
        (x)
      )
    )
  )

 (main MOD_HASH LAUNCHER_ID INNER_PUZZLE_HASH MERKLE_ROOT merkle_proof (a puzzle_reveal puzzle_solution) (sha256tree puzzle_reveal)) 
)

5a084d1786fc0fe43c30bc5fc0233cc1a791cfde.name: --chip_0045-option_contract
5a084d1786fc0fe43c30bc5fc0233cc1a791cfde.clvm:
(mod (
        MOD_HASH
        UNDERLYING_COIN_ID
        UNDERLYING_DELEGATED_PUZZLE_HASH
        INNER_PUZZLE
        inner_solution
    )

    (include curry.clib)
    (include utility_macros.clib)

    (defconstant CREATE_COIN 51)
    (defconstant SEND_MESSAGE 66)

    (defun-inline wrap_puzzle_hash (MOD_HASH UNDERLYING_COIN_ID UNDERLYING_DELEGATED_PUZZLE_HASH inner_puzzle_hash)
        (curry_hashes MOD_HASH
            (sha256 1 MOD_HASH)
            (sha256 1 UNDERLYING_COIN_ID)
            (sha256 1 UNDERLYING_DELEGATED_PUZZLE_HASH)
            inner_puzzle_hash
        )
    )

    (defun-inline wrap_create_coin (MOD_HASH UNDERLYING_COIN_ID UNDERLYING_DELEGATED_PUZZLE_HASH (inner_puzzle_hash . rest))
        (c CREATE_COIN (c (wrap_puzzle_hash MOD_HASH UNDERLYING_COIN_ID UNDERLYING_DELEGATED_PUZZLE_HASH inner_puzzle_hash) rest))
    )

    ; Wraps CREATE_COIN conditions in the option contract layer
    (defun morph_conditions (MOD_HASH UNDERLYING_COIN_ID UNDERLYING_DELEGATED_PUZZLE_HASH conditions melted exercised)
        (if conditions
            (if (= (f (f conditions)) CREATE_COIN)
                (if (= (f (r (r (f conditions)))) -113)
                    ; Allow melting but make sure it's tracked for later
                    (c
                        (f conditions)
                        (morph_conditions MOD_HASH UNDERLYING_COIN_ID UNDERLYING_DELEGATED_PUZZLE_HASH (r conditions) 1 exercised)
                    )
                    ; Wrap the created coin in the option contract layer
                    (c
                        (wrap_create_coin MOD_HASH UNDERLYING_COIN_ID UNDERLYING_DELEGATED_PUZZLE_HASH (r (f conditions)))
                        (morph_conditions MOD_HASH UNDERLYING_COIN_ID UNDERLYING_DELEGATED_PUZZLE_HASH (r conditions) melted exercised)
                    )
                )
                (if (and (= (f (f conditions)) SEND_MESSAGE) (all
                        (= (f (r (f conditions))) 23) ; Puzzle hash => coin id
                        (= (f (r (r (r (f conditions))))) UNDERLYING_COIN_ID) ; Received by underlying coin id
                    ))
                    (assert (= (f (r (r (f conditions)))) UNDERLYING_DELEGATED_PUZZLE_HASH)
                        ; Make note that the option has been exercised
                        (c
                            (f conditions)
                            (morph_conditions MOD_HASH UNDERLYING_COIN_ID UNDERLYING_DELEGATED_PUZZLE_HASH (r conditions) melted 1)
                        )
                    )
                    (c
                        (f conditions)
                        (morph_conditions MOD_HASH UNDERLYING_COIN_ID UNDERLYING_DELEGATED_PUZZLE_HASH (r conditions) melted exercised)
                    )
                )
            )
            (assert (= melted exercised) ; If melted, must also be exercised and vice versa
                ()
            )
        )
    )

    (morph_conditions MOD_HASH UNDERLYING_COIN_ID UNDERLYING_DELEGATED_PUZZLE_HASH (a INNER_PUZZLE inner_solution) () ())
)

aaf5d0676da9c06b02ae94acc7f226c6b583205d.clvm:
; eip712_member_v2.clsp -- CHIP-0043 member for EIP-712 daily keys.
;
; This is the Authority V3 variant of the historical integration fixture.
; It preserves the CHIP-0037 signed payload while emitting the consensus
; ASSERT_MY_COIN_ID opcode (70). The old fixture emitted opcode 73
; (ASSERT_MY_AMOUNT) and remains unchanged for V2 audit reproducibility.

(mod (PREFIX_AND_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR TYPE_HASH PUBKEY
      delegated_puzzle_hash
      my_id signed_hash signature)

  (defconstant ASSERT_MY_COIN_ID 70)

  (if (all
        (not (secp256k1_verify PUBKEY signed_hash signature))
        (not (softfork
                (q . 2745)
                (q . 1)
                (mod
                  (PREFIX_AND_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR TYPE_HASH my_id
                   delegated_puzzle_hash signed_hash)
                  (if (= (keccak256 PREFIX_AND_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR
                                    (keccak256 TYPE_HASH my_id
                                               delegated_puzzle_hash))
                         signed_hash)
                      ()
                      (x)))
                (list PREFIX_AND_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR TYPE_HASH my_id
                      delegated_puzzle_hash signed_hash))))
      (list (list ASSERT_MY_COIN_ID my_id))
      (x)))

8b5b948a4c0e713bcb0b28ddb85cc1609d799b40.clvm:
; Forge LP melt inner. Testnet research only; unaudited.
;
; The CAT inner puzzle that a burning LP coin must wrap. Its whole purpose is to
; have exactly one behavior, so that binding a coin to this puzzle hash is proof
; the coin's entire amount is destroyed.
;
; The pool derives the burning coin's id as
;   sha256(parent + cat_puzzle_hash(lp_asset_id, THIS_HASH) + burn)
; and asserts an announcement from it. Because this puzzle emits the -113 melt
; and nothing else -- no CREATE_COIN that could pay the amount onward, no branch,
; no caller-supplied conditions -- a coin wrapping it cannot both satisfy the
; pool and keep its LP. That is what makes a reserve release conditional on a
; real supply reduction.
;
; `lp_action` is validated by the TAIL, and `lp_tail` is pinned by the CAT layer
; (the coin's puzzle hash commits to the asset id, which is the TAIL's tree hash),
; so neither can be swapped for something the pool did not authorize.
;
; Deliberately NOT parameterised: any extra argument is another thing a caller
; could vary, and this puzzle's security comes from having nothing to vary.

(mod (lp_tail lp_action)
  ; The magic amount -113 tells the CAT layer to run the TAIL. With no other
  ; CREATE_COIN in the output, the coin's full amount is melted.
  (list (list 51 () -113 lp_tail lp_action))
)

66811aedacdefe1228ecf5c9553e02627173b81d.name: --forge_clsp-v16-clsp-forge_lp_mint_inner
66811aedacdefe1228ecf5c9553e02627173b81d.clvm:
; Forge V11 LP mint inner. Testnet research only; unaudited.
;
; The CAT inner puzzle the LP genesis ("eve") coin must wrap on an add. The
; pool derives the eve's id as sha256(parent + cat_puzzle_hash(lp_asset_id,
; THIS_HASH) + 1) and sends its message to exactly that coin, so the only way
; to satisfy the pool is to run this puzzle, whose only outputs are the minted
; coin and the -113 mint.
;
; V11 CHANGE, and the only one: the minted coin carries a CHIP-0020 hint equal
; to its own inner puzzle hash. V10 minted with a bare CREATE_COIN and on
; 2026-09-04 that hid 49,879 LP from the wallet that owned it. The hint is not
; a free field -- it is `settlement_hash` itself, so it is a function of the
; holding rather than a statement about it, and nothing needs to assert it.
;
; `settlement_hash` and `amount` remain the depositor's choice: the pool
; re-derives the canonical mint from its invariant and refuses any other
; figure, and the TAIL checks the delta against the real CAT ring.

(mod (settlement_hash amount lp_tail lp_action)
  (list
    (list 51 settlement_hash amount (list settlement_hash))
    (list 51 () -113 lp_tail lp_action)
  )
)
